- Tiled/region-oriented pixel storage, selections, masks, compositing, persistence. No whole-canvas rewrites.
- Copy-on-write and immutable historical state; operations must not mutate unrelated layers, sources, cached tiles, or prior history.

- Preserve existing Brush/Eraser workflows; add neighboring tools.
- Local-first, browser-compatible, recovery-aware, existing file/document model preserved.
